speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of Strategy Group (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: Singapore has succeeded because we have been able to anticipate challenges and opportunities, take a long-term view, and plan ahead to prepare for the future.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of Strategy Group (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: We are entering a new phase of nation-building.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of Strategy Group (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: The world around us is changing rapidly and often in unexpected ways.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of Strategy Group (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: Our own economy is undergoing a fundamental transformation amidst a shift in the global economic centre of gravity towards Asia.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of Strategy Group (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: Technology will change the way we live, work and play.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of Strategy Group (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: And the texture of our society is evolving as our population ages and new social challenges emerge.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of Strategy Group (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: This more complex landscape will require policy responses to challenges that are still emerging and, therefore, not yet well-defined.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of Strategy Group (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: It will require Government agencies to work more closely together because solutions to policy challenges will increasingly cut across Ministry domains.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of Strategy Group (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: We will also need to tackle the challenges of today while, at the same time, building for tomorrow.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of Strategy Group (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: We will continue to strengthen whole-of-Government planning and execution.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of Strategy Group (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: First, we will stretch the bounds of our ambition for a better future that we will build together.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of Strategy Group (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: Second, we will ensure that all parts of the Government work in stronger alignment in pursuit of these goals.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of Strategy Group (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: Third, we will ensure that resources and capabilities support our national priorities.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of Strategy Group (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: Our changing demography has wide-ranging effects on many Government strategies, including in areas, such as the economy, healthcare, infrastructure, defence planning and social cohesion.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of Strategy Group (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: In the medium term, our ageing population presents both challenges and opportunities to sustain a dynamic economy.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of Strategy Group (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: The slower growth of our local workforce provides a strong impetus to press on with economic restructuring.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of Strategy Group (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: In doing so, our population policies will support a cohesive society and vibrant economy.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of Strategy Group (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: Singapore will continue to be a place where Singaporeans are proud to call home.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of Strategy Group (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: Climate change is another cross-cutting issue that requires a whole-of-nation response.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of Strategy Group (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: Singapore must address climate change and safeguard our collective future.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of Strategy Group (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: As a low-lying, tropical island state, we must develop plans to address the impact of climate change, such as rising sea levels, higher temperatures and more extreme rainfall patterns.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of Strategy Group (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: At the same time, we need to work as part of the international community to reduce our collective carbon footprint.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of Strategy Group (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: We will fulfill our commitment to the Paris Agreement.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of Strategy Group (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: The Government will implement the carbon tax, and work together with all stakeholders, including people and businesses, to reduce energy use, increase energy efficiency and reduce greenhouse gases.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of Strategy Group (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: To this end, 2018 has been designated as the Year of Climate Action to raise awareness and intensify the national effort to bring down our emissions and adopt sustainable practices.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of Strategy Group (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: Just as we had seized new opportunities to develop solutions to address water scarcity, we can and must do the same for climate change.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of Strategy Group (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: We will leverage our strengths in research, technology and innovation to seize green growth opportunities.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of Strategy Group (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: We will develop solutions to address sustainability challenges in our region and beyond, as countries make the transition towards low-carbon economies.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of Strategy Group (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: This will create good opportunities for Singaporeans and our companies, and ensure Singapore remains economically competitive, sustainable, vibrant and liveable.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of Strategy Group (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: Across the Government, we are building from a position of strength.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of Strategy Group (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: We will continue to plan for the medium to long term and lay strong foundations for our collective future.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of Strategy Group (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: We invite all Singaporeans to join us in this journey.
